title: Comprehensive perturbation of transcription factors in human cardiomyocytes reveals the regulatory architecture of congenital heart disease.
authors: Takeuchi, Chikara; Sivakumar, Sushama; Sundarrajan, Anjana; Wang, Yihan; Goetsch, Sean C; Zhao, Huan; Wang, Lei; Nzima, Mpathi; Deng, Minnie; Kulkarni, Kartik N; Xu, Lin; Wu, Jun; Posner, Bruce A; Chahrour, Maria H; Kraus, W Lee; Munshi, Nikhil V; Hon, Gary C
journal: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology
one_liner_zh: 该文通过大规模扰动人类心肌细胞中的转录因子并构建调控网络，结合深度学习模型预测扰动转录因子，但核心是基因表达调控而非TF-DNA三维互作建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: Over 100 genes have been implicated in congenital heart disease (CHD), yet the genetic basis for >50% of CHD remains unexplained. A key challenge is to define the regulatory architecture of CHD genes. Here, we systematically perturb 1983 transcription factors (TFs) during cardiomyocyte differentiation of human stem cells. Our analysis links TFs to gene expression phenotypes across scales and nominates TFs in cardiac cell fate commitment, dosage sensitivity, and transposable element regulation. By deriving TF-gene regulatory networks from experimental perturbation, we gain insights into how developmental networks are structured, use this map to interpret the regulatory architecture of CHD, and deorphanize TFs with roles in CHD that have been under-sampled by genetic studies. To extend these networks to include enhancer-TF-gene linkages, we also perturb 981 putative enhancers of TFs. Finally, we develop a deep learning transformer model to accurately predict perturbed TFs from altered transcriptomes, which we apply to interpret CHD patient transcriptomes. This reference map represents a foundational platform to model the functions of TFs and aids in interpreting CHD variants and mechanisms.
abstract_zh: 超过100个基因已被证实与先天性心脏病（CHD）相关，然而，超过50%的CHD遗传基础仍未阐明。一个关键挑战在于界定CHD基因的调控架构。在此，我们系统性地扰动了人类干细胞心肌分化过程中的1983个转录因子（TFs）。我们的分析将转录因子与跨尺度的基因表达表型联系起来，并提名了在心脏细胞命运决定、剂量敏感性和转座子调控中起作用的转录因子。通过从实验扰动中推导转录因子-基因调控网络，我们深入了解了发育网络的结构组织方式，利用这一图谱解读CHD的调控架构，并揭示了在遗传研究中采样不足的、与CHD相关的转录因子的功能。为将这些网络扩展至包含增强子-转录因子-基因的关联，我们还扰动了981个推定的转录因子增强子。最后，我们开发了一种深度学习变换器模型，能够从改变的转录组中准确预测受扰动的转录因子，并将其应用于解读CHD患者转录组。这一参考图谱为模拟转录因子功能提供了基础平台，并有助于解读CHD变异及其机制。
